subject: P-7F3K9Q.T2
objective: Make TagStore.addTag store every tag trimmed, NFC-normalized and lowercased, at most once per note, so that the two frozen tag tests pass, without touching the tests or anything outside src/store/.
non_goals: Showing or editing tags in the HTTP API or the web UI.
steps: Read tests/notes/tags.test.ts to learn the expected TagStore.addTag behaviour.
Add normalizeTag in src/store/tags.ts: trim, then NFC, then a locale-independent lowercase.
Implement TagStore.addTag on top of NoteStore, skipping a tag the note already has.
Make NoteStore.load treat a missing tags array as no tags.
Run npm test locally, then submit.
assumptions: Notes are stored one JSON document per note, as ADR-7KQ2B describes.
The store has a single writer, so addTag needs no locking.
